status: decompiler reference only; not original or rebuildable source
limitations: Coverage denominator is Ghidra's observed procedure inventory, not a proof of every executable byte or original function.
Decompiler output can contain bad instructions, unreachable-block removal, unknown types or wrong calling conventions.
Successful decompilation is a tool result, not semantic correctness or rebuildability.
External functions are indexed but their bodies are not invented or emitted.
Unrequested, null and failed procedures remain explicit in the index; no placeholder implementation is generated.
Aliases are deduplicated by address. Repeated observations remain indexed; the last successful body is emitted.
A missing inventory means total code coverage is unknown.
